subject: prd/contract-gate
statement: If a currency-disposition projection or record is missing when referenced, unreadable, malformed, carries an unknown schema version or key, or lacks a required field, then the system shall emit a `configuration-error` verdict naming the projection, record, and defect, run no currency exception for that record, and refuse planning fail-closed
intent: configuration error with the exact record and repair
fit_criterion: one fixture per malformed class produces no cleared edge and no clean verdict; independent ordinary checks remain represented according to the verdict contract
